title: Lightly Roasted Greek Baby Aubergine Skewers
description: A delicious and healthy Greek dish featuring roasted baby aubergines, perfect for a brunch mood, with a resinous and tender flavor, and diabetic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the baby aubergines onto skewers, leaving a small space between each aubergine.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, oregano, thyme, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto the aubergines.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the aubergines in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with feta cheese and olives.
Return the skewers to the oven and roast for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is slightly melted.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
